# Liquid Glass Suite

> Apple Liquid Glass agent skills for web pages. Four `SKILL.md` skills covering
> CSS/SVG displacement, WebGL2 refraction, React, Tailwind v4, Safari/WebKit
> fallbacks, optical measurement, debugging and executable verification.
> MIT licensed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

Install:

```text
/plugin marketplace add admos98/liquid-glass-suite
/plugin install liquid-glass-suite@admos98-skills
```

Generic Agent Skills CLI:

```sh
npx skills add admos98/liquid-glass-suite
```

## Facts

- Version: 2.0.1.
- Skills: `liquid-glass` (apply), `liquid-glass-optics`, `liquid-glass-debug`, `liquid-glass-native`.
- Web paths: universal `blur() saturate()` fallback; conservatively gated Chromium
  SVG backdrop lens; explicit-texture WebGL2 that cannot read arbitrary DOM.
- Liquid Glass is refraction, not blur: the backdrop bends near the boundary while
  the centre stays readable.
- Verification: 17 package tests, 11 Playwright browser tests, offline showcase
  build check, strict plugin manifest validation.
- Live showcase: https://admos98.github.io/liquid-glass-suite/

## Known limits

- No Vue, Svelte, Astro, Solid or SSR adapters are shipped.
- The eval results table is intentionally empty; no model-driven runs are claimed.
- Native Apple samples were not compiled on Apple hardware.
- No external Apple pixel baseline is bundled; Apple publishes no numeric Liquid
  Glass specification.
- Playwright Chromium is not a real iPhone. One owner-tested physical-device run
  is recorded, with iOS/Safari versions unrecorded.
